# RunYourAI Website Instructions for GitHub Copilot

Read and apply [WEBSITE-MASTER-STANDARD.md](../WEBSITE-MASTER-STANDARD.md) **before** working on any website, prospect demo, mockup, edit or visual review.

Also read [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md), [docs/WEBSITE-NORTH-STAR-QC.md](../docs/WEBSITE-NORTH-STAR-QC.md) and [WEBSITE-QC-STANDARD.md](../WEBSITE-QC-STANDARD.md).

All mockups must meet premium, business-specific quality standards. Do not fabricate real-business claims, testimonials, credentials, prices or other facts. Verify imagery, responsiveness, functionality, accessibility, navigation, conversion, and cross-page consistency.

**Mandatory:** inspect actually rendered full pages at narrow mobile (~360px), tablet (~768px), and desktop (~1440px). Code inspection or build success alone is not visual verification. Include screenshot/preview evidence, mark all required gates PASS/FAIL/NOT VERIFIED, and report NOT READY FOR APPROVAL if rendered inspection is unavailable or any gate fails.
